name: ai-siege-starves-out
description: An AI-versus-AI siege the player is no party to: Russia besieges Estonia, whose garrison is already below the 5% rout threshold, holds no forts, and has no food left. The next turn's income pass starves the garrison out and the siege resolves as a conquest. The player is nowhere near it, so the conquest must go to Russia and must NOT raise a battle screen. Reaching the rout band is done by COMPOSITION, not attrition: the siege's startingDef records a garrison of a million while the territory holds a thousand, which is the state a siege that has ground on for several turns is actually in.
